messages:
Maya: Hi — just got my company M1 Air and finished out-of-box setup, but when I try to install Homebrew it pops a 'requires administrator permission' dialog. MDM portal shows me as enrolled but no admin. Any advice?
Jordan (IT): Welcome Maya! Can you run `system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep Serial` and paste the serial here? Also check System Settings > Privacy & Security > Profiles for any pending profile.
Maya: Serial: C02M1X9Z8QW. No profiles listed in Settings. Installer prompt text: 'Installer requires administrator privileges to continue.'
MDM-Bot: Device C02M1X9Z8QW status: DEP enrolled, profile applied: "corp-standard-2026". Last contact: 2026-05-11T09:04:22Z. Admin assignment: none.
Rohan: Sometimes macOS hides the config prompt if OOBE was completed quickly. Jordan, can you resend the enrollment push?
Jordan (IT): Yep. Two safe paths: 1) resend enrollment so Maya accepts and we can push a short-lived admin profile, or 2) I can do a remote session and run the necessary installer commands without granting admin. Which do you want, Maya?
Maya: I'd prefer the remote session — I'm at lunch but can do a 15–20m call. Don't want persistent admin.
Jordan (IT): Sounds good. I'll schedule a quick screen-share. In the meantime, if you need to install Rosetta or run x86 tools, tell me and we'll include that in the session.
Maya: I do need Rosetta for one legacy dev tool. 15:15 PT works for me.
SRE-Bot: Note: for machines that need Docker for Mac, recommend Rosetta + Apple Silicon build; if Docker wants privileged installs, we'll use the session.
Jordan (IT): Scheduled Zoom 15:15 PT. I'll remote in and run the installer commands under my account so you don't get admin access. After we finish I'll verify your MDM status and FileVault.
Maya: Cool. Thanks.
[15:20 PM — screen-share session]
Jordan (IT): I'm initiating a temporary privileged command via Jamf remote. Running:
```
sudo /usr/sbin/softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"
```
Maya: I see the authentication prompt on my screen, accepted. Installer is running.
Jordan (IT): Homebrew finished. I'm fixing permissions on /opt/homebrew and /usr/local: `sudo chown -R maya /opt/homebrew` and `sudo chown -R maya /usr/local` where needed.
Maya: Installer completed, brew doctor looks clean, installed git, node, zsh. Thanks.
Jordan (IT): Quick checks: FileVault enabled? Maya: Yes, FileVault ON and recovery key escrowed. MDM-Bot shows a check-in.
MDM-Bot: Device C02M1X9Z8QW check-in: 2026-05-11T15:42:10Z. Profile: corp-standard-2026. FileVault escrow: confirmed.
Jordan (IT): Since you preferred no admin, I didn't add you to the admin group. I logged the actions and attached the session transcript to ticket IT-5102.
Maya: Confirming I do not have sudo rights now (`sudo -l` returns: user maya is not in the sudoers file). All dev tools work. Appreciate the help :tada:
Rohan: Welcome to the team! If you want my VS Code settings or a devcontainer for the M1, ping me.
Jordan (IT): Closing loop — if you need anything else (dotfiles, Docker entitlement), reopen this thread or file IT ticket.
Maya: Will do, thanks again!
